jsonld_raw.name: FASHIONABLY LONDON EDP 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ).
jsonld_raw.description:
FASHIONABLY LONDON EDP 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ). Evokes the relaxed sophistication of London and that summer breeze drifting through the city: a stroll through Knightsbridge, a coffee break, the open light of Hyde Park. Bergamot adds luminous freshness, rose introduces a modern femininity, and musk creates a clean, polished base that blends seamlessly.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Musky floral | Elegant, luminous, and contemporary.
